name: B10-0324/2026 (Verts/ALE) – Deteriorating situation of political prisoners in Belarus, in particular the case of Aliaksandra Pulinovich
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the deteriorating situation of political prisoners in Belarus, in particular the case of Aliaksandra Pulinovich
part_text:
The European Parliament is not changing any law here. It is stating its position and asking for action. It calls for the release of Aliaksandra Pulinovich, a young activist held in Belarus, and of all other political prisoners there. It asks Belarus to treat detainees humanely and let lawyers and families visit. It also asks the European Union to keep documenting abuses, help victims, ease visas for people fleeing Belarus, and widen sanctions on those responsible.

- **What changes:** Nothing yet. These are requests and opinions, not binding decisions.
- **Who it affects:** Political prisoners in Belarus, including Pulinovich, and Belarusians seeking safety in the EU.
- **What happens next:** The resolution is sent to EU institutions and Belarusian authorities; follow-up depends on them.
